data.title: Ibiza
data.about:
Unleash your senses and immerse yourself in the vibrant spirit of Ibiza at Damac Lagoons—a captivating residential development brought to life by Damac Properties. Prepare to be enchanted by the allure of Spanish-inspired living right in the heart of Dubai, where an exquisite collection of 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses eagerly await your arrival. 

Step into a world where every breath is filled with the essence of the Mediterranean Island lifestyle, where cascading water features and exhilarating adventures await, surpassing even your wildest dreams. Indulge in a lifestyle where celebration and the art of living harmoniously unite in Ibiza. Discover a realm where vibrant nightlife thrives, beckoning you to embrace the city’s pulse. Surrender yourself to the hypnotic rhythm of a foam party, where laughter and exhilaration intertwine. Allow the mesmerizing beats of a DJ performance to guide you into a realm of euphoria. Ibiza at Damac Lagoons promises an extraordinary journey that transcends mere existence, transporting you to a realm of endless excitement, unforgettable experiences, and treasured memories that will forever define your notion of true indulgence.

location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Designed for those seeking an effortless lifestyle, this prime location offers seamless connectivity and quick access to nearby attractions. As a bonus, residents will enjoy the serene lifestyle that comes with living near the Damac Hills community. With easy access to major road networks, including Hessa Street, you can explore all Dubai offers without any hassle.

  • 05 Minutes – Jebel Ali School
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club
  • 12 Minutes – Dubai Autodrome
  • 13 Minutes – Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 14 Minutes – Dubai International Stadium
  • 14 Minutes – City Centre Me’aisem
  • 24 Minutes – Mall of the Emirates
